# generator-shortcuts

The strongest simple shortcut groups every cell of a color as one object and
anti-transposes that union bounding box. Every canonical color occurs in only
one component, so this fits all three labelled canonical pairs (both splits).
A second rival uses a fixed 3x3 frame: all canonical frames are 3x3, so it also
fits 3/3.

Exact emitted counterexamples are in
`repo/generators/538503abef57/counterexamples/repeated_color_variable_frame.json`.
They were generated with seed 41, sample_index 0, easy difficulty, no overrides,
from final generator SHA
`ef7c0b0e3b5615546734915c0258e749960614810dcd7690f8e92304cc06227d`.
The file includes complete input grids, actual Racket outputs and each rival's
wrong output. `checks/rival-probe-final/reference.json` is the native receipt;
executed canonical rule hash is `2fbbe9d88e5d`.

The retained task-local `workspace/probe_rivals.py` loads current declarations
and uses the public Racket API. Its 15-input run confirms canonical fit 3/3 for
both shortcuts, generated refutations 6/12 for each, and 12/12 refutations of
local main-diagonal and half-turn alternatives. The witness is ordinary default
production support, not only validator-admitted or hand-authored input.

Two separated objects of the same color can make a whole-color reflection
exchange their positions, while the intended rule keeps each local anchor.
Small hand-made controls and independent baseline-bound Racket checks remain
in `checks/rival-review/`. Its minimal 4x4 and single-object 3x3 controls are
outside the repaired sampler's full-frame/count domain. The emitted final
witness above is the acceptance evidence.

Lesson sufficiency is checked separately: 300 native lessons with three demos
and one query, and all 1,200 query rotations, have no ambiguity against the four
declared rivals. This is finite evidence, not a guarantee against all hypotheses.
